notes.title: 1.0.9 Patch Available Now!
notes.notes:
Greetings,

the latest patch for Darfall is ready and released. 

This update brings several highly requested features: the [b]Patrol command[/b], the ability for [b]players to manually order towers to target enemies[/b], and a fix for [b]items not being clickable in Fog of War[/b].

Scoring has also been updated: [b]each demon portal destroyed now gives +1500 score[/b], up to 4500 total. You can now take out just one portal before the final wave for a solid bonus, instead of needing all three.

To highlight your performance in survival scores, we’ve added a [b]new post-game scoreboard[/b] with a full breakdown of your best runs:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/8a0e11b25a438cfb9f26829569e771614991b5ed.jpg[/img]

[h2]1.0.9 Patch Notes[/h2]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Survival: Added a score table for each map to the Survival map
[*] Scenario Editor: Added entity and blueprint comparison condition
[*] Enemies attacking walls will now switch targets to attackers if they are within line of sight
[*] Ballistas and Towers can now be manually targeted by right-clicking on an enemy
[*] Ballistas and Towers now prioritize enemies that deal damage to them
[*] Added: Patrol command (P)
[/list]

[h3]Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Survival: Each destroyed portal now grants +1500 score
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Campaign: Fixed an issue where villagers could get stuck when their path was blocked in Mission 5
[*] Campaign: Adjusted event timing to reduce unnecessary waiting in Mission 5
[*] Campaign: Fixed an issue where supply carts couldn’t reach the Pylon due to barricades in Mission 6
[*] Scenario Editor: Fixed wander range override resetting after reloading a map
[*] Fixed flickering in the loading UI after cutscenes when FPS are low
[*] Fixed interactions with objects in Fog of War shrouds not working properly
[*] Fixed an issue where queued actions using Shift would stop if an enemy was inside the Fog of War
[*] Fixed an issue where queued actions didn't display units paths, except for the Hero
[*] Fixed an issue where keybinds were reset after closing and reopening the game
[/list]

If you encounter any issues or want to share a suggestion, feel free to do so in our discord [url=https://discord.com/channels/826887508326613042/1066300594203152405]suggestions[/url] forum, or [url=https://discord.com/channels/826887508326613042/1066300698834251816]bug-reports[/url] forum respectively.

Farewell,
SquareNite team from beyond the darkness of Darfall Wastes

notes.notes:
Greetings,

the latest patch for Darfall is ready and released. 

We’ve added a small but handy feature: you can now choose between [b]Classic RTS[/b] and [b]Hero-Centric[/b] control schemes. If you're coming from games like Warcraft 3 or Age of Empires, this lets you jump in with familiar keybindings right away. It’s a simple auto-rebind option, but it saves time and makes the first experience smoother.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/19f8b9b64171d2ae6e84e0e921e0ba57ce788b80.png[/img]

Some little environment improvements, already highlighted in previous dev blog
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/f14163370819e4ab161229f242a9e26e7e34c252.png[/img]


[h2]0.15.0 Patch Notes[/h2]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added presets to choose between RTS Classic vs Hero-Centric control scheme
[*] Guard Mode is now reworked to have same functionality as the Hold Position you know from other classic RTS games
[*] Added Stop command for your units
[*] Scenario Editor: Added action to enable persistent inventory and equipment after hero death
[*] Scenario Editor: Corpses now have disabled outlines
[*] Scenario Editor: Added action to modify loot drop percentage
[*] Added end-game hero announcement
[*] Added map details and doodads to generation
[*] Grass can now be disabled
[/list]

[h3]Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Halo of Life now heals only units
[*] Adjusted loot and drop balance
[*] Rebalanced overall mana orb distribution
[*] Adjusted upgrade and armory drops from chests and orcs
[*] Increased food drops from orc structures
[*] Increased food drops in the Deadland biome
[*] Updated hero abilities
[*] Swamp tree resource reduced from 150 to 30
[*] Increased perks cost and power
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Enemy units could walk through Engineer's Walls
[*] Corruption damage caused FPS spikes
[*] Destroy popup showed incorrect building after reselection
[*] Player-controlled override not working properly after saving and loading
[*] Minimap was revealed when the game ended
[*] Issue with loading the hero screen
[*] Keep deletion was not properly prevented
[*] Structures could be built partially outside of lit areas
[*] Orc Warlord spinning speed was incorrect when pushed back

[/list]

If you encounter any issues or want to share a suggestion, feel free to do so in our discord [url=https://discord.com/channels/826887508326613042/1066300594203152405]suggestions[/url] forum, or [url=https://discord.com/channels/826887508326613042/1066300698834251816]bug-reports[/url] forum respectively.

notes.title: Promising RTS and city builder hybrid Darfall locks in release date
notes.notes:
How many genres is too many to merge together in a new Steam game? Three? Four? Well, the real answer is: as many as you like, just so long as it keeps you hooked and offers up something novel. From what I've seen so far of Darfall - an upcoming mashup of RTS games, city builders, class-based RPGs, and horde-slaying action games - it seems to be finding that sweet spot. With its Steam demo leaving a good impression, this Paradox-back strategy game is shaping up nicely, and now Darfall has confirmed that its release date isn't too far away.

Read the rest of the story...

RELATED LINKS:
New city builder RTS hybrid from Stellaris dev is playable now

notes.title: Major Changes to Demo for City Builder Fest
notes.notes:
Greetings, adventurers!

Our artisans were working hard for quite some time and now are ready to present a shiny new version of the Demo! Just in time for City Builder & Colony Sim Fest - in which we are participating.

While your gaze might see a short patch note below, don't be deceived - just one of those changes overhauls the whole game! And we are talking about the graphics of course.  

Here you can see the new look of Darfall. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/c0b592be7c059c35be8ba77b0c57ad08c9924c7e.jpg[/img]

But graphics aren't the only improvement - other fixes and changes made by our skilled artificers you can find below.

And don't forget to share your thoughts about new visuals!

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list][*] Overhaul of graphics into stylized look
[*] Reworked building upgrades for easier upgrading[/list]
[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list][*] Survival: Announcement with a timer for the Final Wave
[*] Survival: UI showing the number of Final Wave demons remaining
[*] Survival: Short cutscene showing demons when the Final Wave spawns
[*] Scenario Editor: Added map rule to disable fear of dark
[*] AI pathfinding
[*] Tutorial rework for better gameplay understanding[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list][*] Survival: Fixed fish spawning far from shore
[*] Survival: Entities generated from camp now has leash
[*] Scenario Editor: Fixed duplicated scenarios
[*] Scenario Editor: Fixed camera rotation jump after cutscene ends
[*] Scenario Editor: Fixed lag when region reveals fog of war
[*] Fixed: Crafting queue wasn't working properly
[*] Fixed: Barracks rally point offset after game load[/list]

See you in Darfall!

[b]Greetings, Darfall Players![/b]

We’re thrilled to announce that the latest content update, [b]0.11[/b], is now live!

This update focuses on polishing the experience with numerous fixes and tweaks, but the spotlight is on the addition of Chinese and German localization, a brand-new RPG-styled hero selection screen, and the introduction of class Traits.

[h2]Hero Selection[/h2]

To enhance the immersive fantasy experience of Heroes, we’ve reworked the character selection screen! You can now view your heroes in fully 3D, bringing the RPG vibes to life, similar to what you’d find in MMORPGs. Since Darfall blends city-building and RPG gameplay, we could never miss this feature!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/9438c11c77661461f8034cd961240e724d013916.gif[/img]
(Huge props to our talented artist Jakub for making such an fantastic scene)

The screen will be improved with few more details and animations as we will near the full release this year.

[h2]Class Traits[/h2]

Each hero now comes with a unique trait tailored to their class. In the Demo, this is available for the Mage, Ardan.

You can now experience his Energy Overflow trait: locate an Energy Fountain on the map, stand inside it, and charge up the buff to its full duration.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/70e543eed1877625b5612dd3d7acc1a958f32285.jpg[/img]

With the Energy Overflow buff, Ardan’s energy capacity doubles, enabling him to unleash a devastating barrage of magic on invaders, or the occasional unlucky orcs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/deb53dca05a0dab5e3ff7f067a1c2372c5ecd1e1.jpg[/img]

[h2]0.11 Changelist[/h2]

[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Survival: Brand new RPG style hero selection screen
[/list]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased the size of the "Under Attack" marker for better visibility
[*] Added German and Chinese localizations
[*] Reworked the model of the Cryptstalker
[*] Scenario Editor: Updated scenario editor icons
[*] Scenario Editor: Improved scenario erase tooltips
[*] Scenario Editor: Can now place minimap markers using trigger actions
[*] Survival: Added roads to survival maps
[/list]

[h3]Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased Spider Queen egg laying distance
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the sound of ballista and tower attacks wasn't played
[*] Fixed an issue where the hero's level XP wasn't displayed
[*] Fixed an issue where the salvaging UI became stuck
[*] Fixed an issue where the in-game console was cutting off part of messages
[*] Fixed an issue with audio distortion while zooming in and out
[*] Scenario Editor: Fixed an issue where copying nested actions didn't work properly
[*] Scenario Editor: Fixed music not playing in scenarios
[*] Survival: Fixed corruption effects that stayed on units forever
[/list]

If you encounter any issues or want to share a suggestion, feel free to do so in our discord [url=https://discord.com/channels/826887508326613042/1066300594203152405]suggestions[/url] forum, or [url=https://discord.com/channels/826887508326613042/1066300698834251816]bug-reports[/url] forum respectively.

As always, we deeply value your feedback and suggestions as we continue to refine Darfall. Thank you for your incredible support, and we can’t wait to hear what you think about this update!

Stay tuned for more exciting updates and improvements,
[b]SquareNite[/b] - from beyond the darkness of the Darfall Wastes.

[h3]Storage Controls - Tutorial[/h3]

notes.title: 0.10 Content Update Available Now! (Demo)
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings, Darfall Players![/b]

We’re excited to announce that the latest content update, [b]0.10[/b], is now live! 

This update brings a host of improvements and new features as we continue working towards the full release. Let’s dive into the highlights of what’s new in this demo update.


[h2]Window Bar Rework[/h2]

The bottom bar has been redesigned to highlight the [b]Storage[/b] and [b]Codex[/b] buttons, previously located near "Repair All." This new layout not only makes these buttons easier to access but also paves the way for future additions, such as a potential Hero Crafting button in later updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/0639a34e0dfd3a9e119b215809ef4044f82751c4.jpg[/img]

With all window buttons now grouped in one place, navigating your interface has never been easier. This redesign also leaves room for future expansions.

[h2]Ability & Perk Book UI Upgrade[/h2]

The [b]Ability[/b] and [b]Perk Book[/b] windows have received a visual and functional rework. With updated art, your character now stands at the center of the Perk Tree, enhancing the feeling of progression and customization.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/989db39b09467481401ff6cc399a2f5a644b3b7a.jpg[/img]

Switching between Perks and Abilities is now seamless, thanks to a clear toggle and a "new point" indicator that ensures you never miss an opportunity to upgrade.

[h2]Survival End Screen Improvements[/h2]

The updated [b]Survival End Screen[/b] now provides detailed information about your score, including a breakdown of the [b]difficulty multiplier[/b] and a new section for [b]Objectives[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/0cf2a6fd6b7a635d00d92ccce3e268122d2c0c5f.jpg[/img]

Destroying portals now properly reflects in your score, rewarding your efforts with a significant bonus.

[h2]Mod.io Integration![/h2]

For content creators and players seeking new scenarios, we’re excited to announce [b]mod.io integration[/b]! This platform allows you to browse, subscribe, and play custom scenarios directly in-game.

[b]Darfall on mod.io:[/b] https://mod.io/g/darfall


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/f941e0d1251f12d97581c4075bd3dcc90f14e4e8.jpg[/img]

Uploading your scenarios is as straightforward as using the Steam Workshop, and mod.io ensures that players can easily explore community creations.

[h2]Scenario Editor Improvements[/h2]

We’ve made several enhancements to the [b]Scenario Editor[/b], making it easier than ever to create your custom maps:

[h3]Custom Items with Icons[/h3]

You can now create custom items, assign names, and upload unique icons. Want a specific quest item to drop from Giant Rats? You can now make it happen!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/56790d8e8478a1701ce10686784ab09dc6c6e589.jpg[/img]

Custom items can be found in the Data Editor window on the second tab.

In the future, we also plan to add a way to modify any stat of an item, like Hitpoints or Damage, and to change existing items, like how much the Plank costs to craft.

[h3]Pathing Grid[/h3]

We have also added an option to display cells blocked by props or structures, helping you visualize AI navigation and player-building restrictions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/91fd287fd337a4ea42f0e1c986fb4d8752843524.jpg[/img]

[h3]Doodad Improvements[/h3]

Doodads serve as visual environment improvements and are designed to be non-interactable by the player in any way. However, we have added the ability to allow doodads to block pathing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/bce3ce4e12bb724d6ee0388b88322383e78616fe.jpg[/img]

This helps immensely when placing doodads like custom mountains or pillars, which previously allowed players to walk straight through them.

[h2]Full Update Notes[/h2]

These are just the highlights of what’s included in [b]0.10[/b]. For the complete list of fixes, improvements, and updates, check out the full changelist below:

[h2]0.10.0 Changelist[/h2]

[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Scenario Editor: You can now create custom items with your custom icons
[*] Added Mod.io integration. Upload, browse, download scenarios via mod.io platform
[/list]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Scenario Editor: Doodads can now mark area as not walkable
[*] Scenario Editor: Doodads can be rotated, scaled and positioned before placement
[*] Scenario Editor: Added Kneel Scout animation for all units
[*] Scenario Editor: Disabled Steam Workshop
[*] Scenario Editor: Can now visualize cells that are blocked by objects like Props or Doodads
[*] Improved UI for Ability Book and Perk Book
[*] Improved UI for opening windows like Codex or Storage
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where fireball spells could hit enemies behind the hero
[*] Survival: Fixed difficulty multipliers do not affect gained score
[*] Fixed an issue where the ballista would not shoot at enemies
[/list]

As always, we deeply value your feedback as we refine Darfall. Thank you for your support, and we look forward to hearing your thoughts on this update! Stay tuned for more updates and improvements.

SquareNite team from beyond the darkness of Darfall Wastes.

notes.title: 0.1.2 Update Release (Demo)
notes.notes:
Hi all, 
The 1.2 demo game version is out that features a more easier starting economy and 2 new tutorial steps that teach you about the importance of map exploration, as well as numerous fixes and improvements.

This update combines 2 patches together, the bigger 1.1 and smaller 1.2.

[h1]1.1 Changelog[/h1]

[h3]New Features[/h3]

- added explore with hero tutorial step
- added reach level 2 tutorial step
- each warrior now has map icon over their head when zooming out to better see them

[h3]Balance[/h3]

- energy recharge rate increased by 33%
- fireball cooldown increased from 3s to 6s
- woodcutter build cost decreased
- quarry build cost decreased
- farm build cost decreased
- storage build cost decreased
- salvaging items now rewards much more resources
- decreased cost for some building upgrades
- lamp aura now costs charcoal instead of mana orbs
- undead camps now drop more mana orbs
- stone gate hitpoints increased from 1500 to 2500
- increased damage of fire circle

[h3]Improvements[/h3]

- hero energy now gets refilled to full when hero levels up
- roads can now be built around outpost
- can now upgrade wooden walls, even when both wooden and stone walls are selected
- added tooltip to hero level and experience count
- added new sound effects
- added text scroll-up when collecting mana orbs
- increased loading screen tip duration, so you can read it better
- added arrow above Grimwick, so people know where to begin
- auto-save now gets triggered every 10mins instead of 5mins

[h3]Fixes[/h3]

- fixed fireball hitting small bones instead of intended enemies
- fixed fireball sometimes hitting enemies behind hero
- fixed assigning workers via cursor not working correctly
- necromancer can no longer shoot through walls
- fixed multiple errors reported by users
- fixed 2nd worker unable to work if only 1 resource left
- fixed game end screen does not pause the game
- fixed salvage tutorial sometimes cannot be completed
- possible fixed issue where loading a game freezes enemies or spawns them at 0,0
- fixed audio and video settings not saving correctly
- fixed enemies can sometimes get stuck when trying to reach unreachable position



[h1]1.2 Changelog[/h1]

[h3]Balance[/h3]

- decreased bow and armor drops

[h3]Improvements[/h3]

- improved fire circle effect

[h3]Fixes[/h3]

- can no longer construct structures near enemies
- fixed ambience volume is sometimes not correct
- fixed typo in one of the tutorial steps

notes.title: Play Beta version NOW!

Hello everyone,

closed "beta" will open this [b]Friday 15:00 CET (06:00 PT)[/b] for all who register via the Steam playtest button.

The playtest will last [b]till next Monday 23:00 CET (14:00 PT)[/b], so reserve your time 😜 

Please don't hesitate to record & stream the gameplay anywhere you like. Also [b]please try to submit any bugs you encounter or send us suggestions, either via discord channels (there will be dedicated channels) or via integrated in-game feedback panel ("bug" button)[/b].
We'll really appreciate those of you who'll report and may promote you to @Tester (on our Discord channel) to get more early builds in the future.

Who is comfortable can [b]record their gameplay with, or without commentary and share it with us[/b] devs (e.g. google drive or youtube as unlisted video) as this helps us greatly to analyse player behaviour or issues you may encounter (you can write us DM with the link afterwards)

As this is only a Demo playtest, it will offer just a [b]limited amount of gameplay where you can survive up to day 6[/b] (then a final wave will come that wipes your entire city and all living things in it 😈 )

For those who request access during the playtest period, we'll regularly let you in.

Martin (and Lukas)
